sentences.text:
The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner for plot nos. 232, 265, 267, 157 situated at Village Aaspur, Pargana Nagar Purab,
Tehsil & District Basti as per provisions of Act No. 30 of 2013.
Further prayer is for a direction for payment of compensation at four times the circle rate, as provided under Government Order dated 19.03.2015.

sentences.text:
The case of the petitioner is that she is bhumidhar of plot nos. 232, 265, 267, 157 Village Aaspur,
Pargana Nagar Purab, Tehsil & District Basti.
Copy of the khatauni has been filed to evidence the same.
Further case of the petitioner is that the State respondents constructed moot khat road over plot nos. 265, 232, 244, 269/ 895, 266kha and 267 belonging to her.

The petitioner places reliance on a report of Lekhpal dated 01.10.2021 in which it is mentioned that gata no. 265, 267 and 232 recorded in the name of the petitioner had got affected by construction of the road.
The case of the petitioner is that no formal acquisition has taken place and the respondents have included the lands of the aforesaid plots of the petitioner without any authority of law.

She is, therefore, entitled to compensation at four times the circle rate as per Government Order dated 19.03.2015.
3.
On 23.07.2024, the following order was passed:-
"1. The instructions furnished by the State-respondents reveal that road has been constructed over Gata Nos. 265, 267 and 232, which admittedly belongs to the petitioner.

Although, it is alleged that a chak-road was in existence since long, but no order has been filed to show that any part of aforeasaid gatas had vested in the Gaon Sabha on account of existence of road.
2. We grant one more opportunity to the respondents to file evidence, if any, in support of their case and which may negate the claim of the petitioner for compensation.

3. Accordingly, we direct respondent no. 3 to file his affidavit and bring on record,
material, if any, as may go to show that any part of the land of the petitioner had vested in the State Government or Gaon Sabha or was reserved for public use during consolidation operations.

4. Put up this case as fresh on 13.08.2024.
5.
Sri Rajeev Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, undertakes to communicate the instant order to respondent no. 3 for due compliance."
4. In compliance of the aforesaid order, the District Magistrate has filed his affidavit and in paragraph-4 it is stated as follows:-

sentences.text:
Not on road Other Gata Numbers which are mentioned in Writ Petition 4. Made from 384/2 - had road; recorded so in CH 41 Part of the road 5. Made from 177/1Mi - had road; recorded so in CH 41 Part of the road 6. 266 Kha Made from 176/1Mi - had road; recorded so in CH 41 Part of the road (road passes through Minjumla number)
7. Made from 117Mi/118Mi Not on road 5.
The State respondents have filed relevant extracts of CH Form 41 to prove that part of old plot nos. 384/2, 177/1M, 176/1M were reserved for road in previous consolidation operations.
The corresponding new gata numbers are 244, 269/895 and 266 kha.
The case taken in the affidavit is that the road was constructed over the aforesaid plots and it does not affect the land of the petitioner.
6. The petitioner has filed a copy of sajra map to demonstrate that her plots fall in the alignment of the road and have been affected.
7. In our opinion, the rival contentions require a factual enquiry and appreciation of evidence, which cannot be done in exercise of writ jurisdiction.

8. We are of the considered opinion that interest of justice would be served by referring the dispute to District Level Committee for being decided in terms of Government Order dated 12.05.2016, to which counsel for the parties also do not have any objection.

9. Accordingly, we dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioner to make a fresh representation along with true attested copy of the instant order before respondent no. 3 within three weeks from today.

On any such representation being made, respondent no. 3 will transmit the same to the Chairperson of the District Level Committee for being decided in terms of Government Order dated 12.05.2016 within next twelve weeks after a proper survey and opportunity of hearing to the petitioner or her representative and any other person likely to be affected thereby.

(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
